synopsis: special instructions for character creation phase, uses =Карточная_Система= to generate stats for wasteland survivor

body.priority: CRITICAL - if you see this quant, character creation process is priority
body.instruction_for_gm:
You see this quant ONLY during character creation.

**WHAT TO DO:**
1. System draws 5 cards for stat distribution (see =Значение_Карт=)
2. Explain distribution rules from =Характеристики=
3. Player distributes 4 best cards (worst discarded) to 4 stats
4. Value = rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches characteristic)
5. Ask about: origin (Vault dweller, wastelander, settler, caravan), background, unique trait
6. Return final stats in response_data

**AFTER CREATION:**
- DON'T request this quant again
- Request =Пустошь=, =Фракции=, =Технологии_Пустоши= as needed
body.instruction_for_quantizer:
DON'T create 'Character' or 'Inventory' quants - they are in game mechanics!

Instead create quants for:
1. UNIQUE character abilities (e.g., 'Мутация', 'Навык_Выживания')
2. Important backstory elements (e.g., 'Убежище_101', 'Месть_за_Семью')
3. Special equipment or contacts

synopsis: core card-based RPG system 'Factorial 52!', uses standard 52-card deck for all checks and combat via =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.description: Card-based tabletop RPG system. All actions resolved by drawing cards. No dice needed - only standard 52-card deck.
body.core_principle: Cards are drawn BEFORE player declares action. GM sees results and uses them for narrative. Player describes intent, GM interprets based on drawn cards.
body.card_drawing: Always draw 2 cards as a pair. Bot draws 2 pairs (4 cards) per turn for flexibility.
body.wasteland_context: In the wasteland, checks involve: firefights, surviving radiation, scavenging ruins, dealing with factions, trading, and fighting mutants.

links.Значение_Карт: card rank values and face card meanings
links.Особые_События: special results from aces, twos, face cards

synopsis: card rank values: 2-10 face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=15; face cards add narrative elements via =Особые_События=

rank_values.Jack: 11 (also triggers: wanderer appears, raider scout, mysterious stranger)
rank_values.Queen: 12 (also triggers: female settler leader, Brotherhood scribe, caravan master)
rank_values.King: 13 (also triggers: faction leader, Brotherhood paladin, settlement boss)

body.narrative_use: Face cards can introduce faction representatives, traders, or threats. Use for storytelling enrichment.

critical_combinations.two_aces: Miraculous find, perfect shot, impossible survival, wasteland legend moment
critical_combinations.two_twos: Catastrophe, weapon jam, radiation spike, ambush, everything goes wrong

links.Особые_События: face cards and critical combos trigger special events

synopsis: four card suits map to =Характеристики=: ♠Spades=Strength, ♥Hearts=Science, ♦Diamonds=Survival, ♣Clubs=Agility

spades.wasteland_use: melee combat, carrying capacity, physical labor, intimidation

hearts.wasteland_use: repair, hacking terminals, medicine, understanding pre-war tech

diamonds.wasteland_use: scavenging, trading, radiation resistance, social interaction

links.Характеристики: each suit corresponds to one characteristic
links.Боевая_Система: suit determines action type in combat

synopsis: four character stats from =Система_Мастей=: Сила(♠), Наука(♥), Выживание(♦), Ловкость(♣); used in =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.starting_values: Typically 25-85 range. Card rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches).

synopsis: out-of-combat skill checks using =Карточная_Система=: 2 cards × 10 + stat + =Бонусы_Мастей= vs difficulty threshold

body.when_to_check: When outcome is uncertain. Walking through safe settlement auto-succeeds. Sneaking past raiders, picking locks, trading require checks.

formula.step3: Add suit/color bonus per card (+20 suit match, +10 color match)

wasteland_examples.picking_lock: Agility check, varies by lock level

synopsis: combat resolution via =Карточная_Система=: black cards(♠♣)=attack, red cards(♥♦)=defense; damage = attack - defense

body.combat_context: Wasteland combat is fast and deadly. Ammo is precious - every shot counts.

combat_flow.step1: Cards dealt to all participants (2 per entity)
combat_flow.step3: Cards revealed, GM narrates with wasteland brutality

attack_types.melee: Uses ♠ Strength - machetes, baseball bats, power fists, bare hands
attack_types.ranged: Uses ♣ Agility - pistols, rifles, laser weapons, shotguns

defense_types.physical: Uses ♦ Survival - cover, armor, tactical retreat
defense_types.technical: Uses ♥ Science - using environment, disabling enemy weapons

body.damage_formula: Attack total - Defense total = Damage dealt
body.ammo_tracking: Ammunition is limited! Track usage. Reloading in combat = vulnerability.
body.critical_hits: Head, heart, limbs. Hitting weak points = increased damage.

synopsis: suit/color matching bonuses for =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=: suit match +20, color match +10 (mutually exclusive)

body.bonus_priority: Suit match takes precedence over color match. Cannot stack both.
body.suit_match: +20 bonus when card suit matches the action type
body.color_match: +10 bonus when card color matches action type (but suit doesn't match)

wasteland_examples.shooting: ♣ card gives +20, ♠ card gives +10, red cards give 0
wasteland_examples.repairing: ♥ card gives +20, ♦ card gives +10, black cards give 0

synopsis: special card combinations for narrative: 2 Aces=miracle, 2 Twos=catastrophe, face cards=plot elements; uses =Значение_Карт=

body.applies_to: ONLY player characters, adds narrative flavor

two_aces.name: Miraculous Moment / Чудесный момент
two_aces.effect: Impossible survival, legendary find, perfect shot
wasteland_examples: Deathclaw decides you're not worth it

two_twos.name: Total Disaster / Полная катастрофа
two_twos.effect: Everything goes wrong, worst possible outcome

face_cards.jack: Wanderer appears - mysterious stranger, scout, messenger
face_cards.queen: Female influence - settlement leader, scribe, caravan boss
face_cards.king: Male authority - faction elder, paladin, raider chief

synopsis: equipment tied to =Система_Мастей=: weapons, armor, chems, tools; bonus = rank × 5 (+10 suit match)

item_mechanics.suit_affinity: Each item belongs to one suit
item_mechanics.value_discovery: Item condition and stats revealed through examination
item_mechanics.equip_limit: Can only use 1 item of each suit type actively

wasteland_item_types.spades: Melee weapons - machetes, sledgehammers, power fists, knives
wasteland_item_types.hearts: Tech items - Pip-Boy, repair kits, medical supplies, hacking tools
wasteland_item_types.diamonds: Armor and survival gear - leather armor, combat armor, rad suits
wasteland_item_types.clubs: Ranged weapons - pistols, rifles, shotguns, energy weapons

body.condition: Items degrade with use. Broken weapon = useless. Repair or replace.

special_items.power_armor: Pre-war military exoskeleton. Rare, requires fusion cores.
special_items.pip_boy: Personal computer. Maps, inventory, radio, Geiger counter. Vault dweller mark.
special_items.energy_weapons: Lasers, plasma. Powerful but rare ammo and hard to repair.

synopsis: character progression via =Проверки= success: +1 XP per successful check, at 10 XP: +1 stat, +1 HP

body.xp_gain: Each successful check grants +1 XP to the characteristic used.

wasteland_progression.reputation: Deeds build reputation with factions and settlements
wasteland_progression.perks: Special abilities unlocked through gameplay and story
wasteland_progression.equipment: Better gear found or crafted as you explore

body.alternative_progression: Completing major quests, special training, or finding rare tech can grant direct stat increases.

synopsis: post-nuclear world: radiation, ruins, survival, new order; setting for all =Проверки= and encounters

body.description: The Great War destroyed the old world in two hours. Over two hundred years have passed. Radiation has receded from most places, but the world is changed forever.
body.geography: Ruined cities, radioactive craters, deserts and dead forests. Rare oases of life around clean water sources.
body.law_of_wasteland: Might makes right. But reputation and connections matter more than brute force. Loners don't survive long.
body.resources: Water, food, ammo, medicine - everything is valuable. Old world left much junk and some treasures.
body.philosophy: War never changes. But people can.

synopsis: major groups of wasteland: Brotherhood of Steel, traders, raiders, settlements; affects social =Проверки=

body.description: In wasteland chaos, people unite. Some for survival, some for power, some for ideology.

major_factions.brotherhood_of_steel: Military order collecting old world technology. Power armor, energy weapons, strict hierarchy. Not always friendly to outsiders.
major_factions.traders_caravans: Lifeblood of wasteland economy. Connect settlements, carry goods and news. Neutral but well-armed.
major_factions.raiders: Marauder gangs. Live by looting and violence. Different tribes with different customs - from relatively civilized to cannibals.
major_factions.settlements: Islands of order. Farmers, traders, craftsmen. Defend their walls and pay tribute to the strong.
major_factions.enclave_remnants: Fragments of old government. Technologically advanced, ideologically dangerous.

synopsis: wasteland creatures: ghouls, super mutants, mutated animals, anomalies; combat via =Боевая_Система=

body.description: Radiation and FEV (Forced Evolutionary Virus) changed life on Earth. Some changes are nightmare, some are chance for survival.

creatures.ghouls: Irradiated humans. Feral ghouls are mindless zombies. Sane ghouls are long-lived, often outcasts. Don't confuse them!
creatures.super_mutants: FEV result. Huge, strong, often dumb. Some are intelligent and even friendly. Most are not.
creatures.deathclaws: Apex predator of wasteland. Fast, deadly, nearly invulnerable. Running is best tactic.
creatures.molerats: Small but pack hunters. Problem for supplies more than health.

body.anomalies: Zones of distorted reality. Radiation pockets, gravity traps, electric fields. Avoid!

synopsis: pre-war technology, improvised gear, power armor, energy weapons, medicine; affects =Характеристики= and combat

body.description: Old world left technology that wasteland cannot reproduce. Who controls technology controls future.

equipment.power_armor: Military exoskeleton. Turns person into tank. Rare, requires training and nuclear batteries.
equipment.energy_weapons: Lasers, plasma. Powerful but rare and hard to repair. Ammo even rarer.
equipment.firearms: From improvised pipes to preserved military samples. Reliable, repairable.
equipment.pip_boy: Personal wrist computer. Maps, inventory, radio, Geiger counter. Vault dwellers have them.
equipment.medicine: Stimpaks (instant healing), Rad-Away (removes radiation), RadX (protection). Chems (buffs and side effects).

body.improvisation: Weapons and armor from junk. Not pretty but works. Wasteland is kingdom of DIY.

synopsis: typical wasteland locations: vaults, settlements, ruins, zones; setting for =Проверки= and encounters

body.description: Wasteland is ruined cities, dangerous zones, and rare oases of civilization.

location_types.vaults: Underground Corporation bunkers. Most were social experiments. Some still sealed.
location_types.settlements: Survivor towns. Walls from junk, armed guards, barter and distrust of strangers.
location_types.city_ruins: Skeletons of metropolises. Dangerous - raiders, mutants, radiation. But loot - old tech, supplies.
location_types.radioactive_zones: Bomb craters, waste dumps. High radiation, mutants, but valuable materials.
location_types.roads_trails: Caravan routes - relatively safe. Wild trails - at your own risk.

body.underground: Subway systems. Shelter from radiation but their own inhabitants and dangers.

synopsis: caps, barter, caravans, valuable resources; currency of the wasteland

body.description: In wasteland everything has price. Bottle caps became universal currency - hard to counterfeit and limited.

economy.currency: Caps. In some regions - ammo or clean water. Pre-war money is toilet paper.
economy.valuable_resources: Clean water, radiation-free food, ammo, stimpaks, nuclear batteries, working electronics.
economy.prices: Stimpak: 25-50 caps. Ammo (10): 5-20 caps. Pistol: 50-150 caps. Rifle: 150-400 caps. Power armor: 2000+ caps.
economy.caravans: Trade caravans are economy's arteries. Brahmin (two-headed cows) carry loads. Guard duty is good work.

body.barter: In remote areas caps are useless. Goods for goods exchange. Barter skill is critical.

synopsis: radiation threat: sources, consequences, protection, treatment; survival mechanic tied to =Характеристики=

body.description: Radiation is invisible killer of wasteland. In water, food, air of contaminated zones. Geiger counter is best friend.

mechanics.sources: Craters, dumps, contaminated water and food, some creatures, nuclear waste.
mechanics.consequences: Light exposure - nausea, weakness. Medium - radiation sickness. Heavy - death or ghoulification.
mechanics.protection: RadX (drug), protective suits, lead lining. Or just stay away.
mechanics.treatment: Rad-Away removes radiation. Rare and valuable medicine. Some doctors do blood transfusions.

body.measurement: Pip-Boy shows level. Without it - by feeling (bad option).
body.threshold: Survival × 2 = rads before sickness sets in.

synopsis: survival skills: scavenging, shelter, hunting, repair; uses =Характеристики= Survival stat

body.description: In wasteland every day is struggle. Those who can't survive don't live long.

skills.scavenging: Ruins full of junk. Need eye to tell valuable from trash. Cans, ammo, medicine, parts.
skills.hunting: Mutated animals are food source. But they hunt back. Radstags (deer), brahmin, molerats - edible.
skills.water: Clean water is life. Dirty can be drunk (radiation), boiled (not always helps), or filtered (if you have means).
skills.shelter: Predators come out at night. Raiders love darkness. Find safe place before sunset - priority.
skills.repair: Everything breaks. Ability to fix weapons, armor, tech - most valuable skill.

body.navigation: Wasteland is no place for the lost. Maps, landmarks, stars. Pip-Boy helps.

synopsis: wasteland chems: buffs, side effects, addiction; risk-reward survival mechanic

body.description: Chems are dark side of survival. Instant boost, but high price.

chems.stimpaks: Instant healing. Safe but rare and expensive.
chems.rad_away: Removes radiation. Necessity in contaminated zones.
chems.jet: Time slowing. Reflexes at limit. Very addictive.
chems.buffout: Strength and endurance. Muscles on steroids. Heart can't take it.

body.addiction: Regular use = addiction. Withdrawal lowers stats. Treatable but difficult.

synopsis: reputation system: relations with factions, consequences of choices; affects social =Проверки=

body.description: In wasteland rumors spread fast. Your actions shape reputation - and it comes back.

mechanics.faction_reputation: Every faction remembers. Help - doors open. Harm - doors close. Permanently.
mechanics.karma: General moral state. Wasteland doesn't judge, but people do. Good karma attracts allies, bad attracts bounty hunters.
mechanics.rumors: Caravans carry news. Save settlement today - three towns know tomorrow.

body.consequences: Killed trader? Caravans avoid you. Saved from raiders? Welcome in settlements.
body.neutrality: Can choose no sides. Difficult but possible. Freelancer - on your own.

synopsis: Corporation Vaults: history, experiments, dwellers, technology; source of =Технологии_Пустоши=

body.description: Vaults are underground Corporation bunkers. Promised salvation. In reality - social experiments on people.

truth.official_version: Nuclear war shelters for the chosen. Self-sufficient for hundreds of years.
truth.reality: Each Vault was an experiment. On psyche, genetics, society. Subjects didn't know.
truth.vault_dwellers: Naive to wasteland realities but educated and technically literate. Pip-Boy is their mark.
truth.technology: Vaults preserved pre-war tech. Medicine, weapons, data. Most valuable prize.

body.sealed_vaults: Some still haven't opened. What's inside? Riches or nightmare?
body.numbers: Each Vault has number. 13, 101, 111 - each has its story.

synopsis: travel methods: on foot, caravans, vehicles, dangers of the road; exploration mechanic

body.description: Wasteland is vast. Distance is enemy. How to get there alive?

methods.on_foot: Slow but reliable. Can hide, avoid dangers. Tiring, need water.
methods.caravans: Pay and ride. Safer, but on caravan's schedule and route.
methods.vehicles: Motorcycles, cars - rare. Need fuel, parts, skill. But speed decides.
methods.brahmin: Pack two-headed cows. Slow but carry much. Stubborn.

body.dangers: Raiders on roads, mutants in wastes, radiation in zones. Night more dangerous than day.
body.navigation: Ruins, rocks, roads. Without map or Pip-Boy - easy to get lost.
